  "explanation": "1) Unmatched closing tag in the first BIBL: after '<TITLE>Project</TITLE> von <AUTHOR>Hiorini</AUTHOR>' there was a second '</TITLE>' after 'Land-Leben' with no opening tag. This made the XML malformed. I added an opening <TITLE> before 'klugen und verst\u00e4ndigen Hau\u00df-Vatter...'. That keeps the tags flat and avoids nesting AUTHOR inside TITLE. That includes the encoding artefacts (mojibake of \u00fc, \u00e4, \u00df, \u00e0, \u00f6 in the Mac-Roman/UTF-8 double encoding). It also includes likely OCR errors such as 'Hiorini' (for Florini, i.e. Franz Philipp Florinus), 'Patter' (Vatter) and 'avelichem' (adelichem). I also kept the existing tag name PRIZE."
